court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Subordinate Judge at Kanchipuram in A.S.No.51 of 2011
facts_of_case: The case arises out of the judgment and decree of the Subordinate Judge at Kanchipuram in A.S.No.51 of 2011, which partly reversed the judgment and decree of the Court of the District Munsif-cum-Judicial Magistrate at Uthiramerur in O.S.No.101 of 2006 dated 18.11.2010. The dispute relates to ancestral properties.

legal_principles.principle: Children from void and voidable marriages have a share in ancestral properties.
legal_principles.held: Whether children from void and voidable marriages have a share in the ancestral properties has been settled by the judgment of the Supreme Court in Revannasiddappa and Another -vs- Mallikarjun and Others (CDJ 2023 SC 805) equivalent to 2023 (10) SCC 1.
cited_cases: Revannasiddappa and Another -vs- Mallikarjun and Others (CDJ 2023 SC 805)

outcome.final_order: The final court order is not specified in the excerpt.
